1: // Minimal Cosmic Drift game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   // Ship state
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     radius: 10,
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Game objects
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   const orbs = [];
24:   let score = 0;
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   // Settings
28:   const ASTEROID_COUNT = 8;
29:   const ORB_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5000; // ms
30:   const THRUST = 0.1;
31:   const ROT_SPEED = 0.07;
32:   const MAX_SPEED = 5;
33: 
34:   // Helpers
35:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
36:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
37: 
38:   // Initialize asteroids
39:   for (let i = 0; i < ASTEROID_COUNT; i++) {
40:     asteroids.push({
41:       x: rand(0, width),
42:       y: rand(0, height),
43:       vx: rand(-1, 1),
44:       vy: rand(-1, 1),
45:       radius: rand(15, 30),
46:     });
47:   }
48: 
49:   // Input handling
50:   const keys = {};
51:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
52:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
53: 
54:   // Orb spawning
55:   function spawnOrb() {
56:     orbs.push({
57:       x: rand(0, width),
58:       y: rand(0, height),
59:       radius: 6,
60:     });
61:   }
62:   setInterval(spawnOrb, ORB_SPAWN_INTERVAL);
63: 
64:   function update() {
65:     if (gameOver) return;
66:     // Ship controls
67:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ROT_SPEED;
68:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ROT_SPEED;
69:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
70:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * THRUST;
71:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * THRUST;
72:     }
73:     // Clamp speed
74:     const speed = Math.hypot(ship.vx, ship.vy);
75:     if (speed > MAX_SPEED) {
76:       ship.vx *= MAX_SPEED / speed;
77:       ship.vy *= MAX_SPEED / speed;
78:     }
79:     // Move ship
80:     ship.x = (ship.x + ship.vx + width) % width;
81:     ship.y = (ship.y + ship.vy + height) % height;
82: 
83:     // Move asteroids
84:     for (const a of asteroids) {
85:       a.x = (a.x + a.vx + width) % width;
86:       a.y = (a.y + a.vy + height) % height;
87:     }
88: 
89:     // Collision ship‑asteroid
90:     for (const a of asteroids) {
91:       if (dist(ship, a) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
92:         gameOver = true;
93:         break;
94:       }
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Collision ship‑orb
98:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
99:       if (dist(ship, orbs[i]) < ship.radius + orbs[i].radius) {
100:         score++;
101:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
102:       }
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   function draw() {
107:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
108:     // Stars background (simple)
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
110:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
111: 
112:     // Draw ship
113:     ctx.save();
114:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
115:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
116:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
117:     ctx.beginPath();
118:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
119:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
120:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
121:     ctx.closePath();
122:     ctx.fill();
123:     ctx.restore();
124: 
125:     // Draw asteroids
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
127:     for (const a of asteroids) {
128:       ctx.beginPath();
129:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
130:       ctx.fill();
131:     }
132: 
133:     // Draw orbs
134:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
135:     for (const o of orbs) {
136:       ctx.beginPath();
137:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
138:       ctx.fill();
139:     }
140: 
141:     // Score
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
144:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
145: 
146:     if (gameOver) {
147:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
148:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
149:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
150:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
151:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
152:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   function loop() {
157:     update();
158:     draw();
159:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
160:   }
161:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162: })();

(End of file - total 162 lines)
</content>
